articles.title: House on the Cautín River / Iragüen Viñuela Arquitectos
english: Completed in 2020, the House on the Cautín River is situated in the scenic area of Malalcahuello, Chile. The project was a result of an unexpected commission, as the client had abandoned another construction project they initiated the same year. This transition offered a fresh start, allowing the architects to explore new possibilities in design and function.

The structure harmonizes with its natural surroundings, utilizing local materials to enhance its aesthetic appeal. Large windows frame the breathtaking views of the Cautín River, flooding the interiors with natural light. The design emphasizes sustainability, providing an immersive experience that connects occupants with the landscape.

As the project evolved, the architects focused on creating open spaces that facilitate social interaction while respecting the environment. The layout encourages a seamless flow between the indoor and outdoor areas, reinforcing the bond between the house and its picturesque setting. This approach illustrates how architecture can respond to both client needs and ecological considerations.
chinese:
這座位於智利馬拉爾卡維的家於2020年完工。該項目因客戶放棄了同年啟動的另一個建設項目而意外委託給我們。這一轉變提供了一個全新的開始，讓建築師們探索不同的設計和功能。
該結構與周圍自然環境和諧共處，利用當地材料增強其美學吸引力。大型窗戶框住了壯麗的卡烏丁河景觀，給室內帶來了充足的自然光。設計強調可持續性，提供一種沉浸式的體驗，使居住者與景觀緊密相連。
隨著項目的發展，建築師們專注於創造開放空間，以促進社交互動，同時尊重環境。佈局促進室內與室外區域之間的無縫流動，強化了房屋與其優美環境之間的聯繫。這種方法展示了建築如何回應客戶需求和生態考量。

articles.title: Woods Bagot adds modular terminal with aluminium fins to LAX
english: Woods Bagot, an architecture studio, utilized off-site production methods to accelerate the construction of a new satellite concourse at Los Angeles International Airport. This innovative approach expanded the Tom Bradley International Terminal by adding 150,000 square feet and eight gates while ensuring minimal disruption to airport operations. The terminal structures were built 1.75 miles away and transported to the site using self-propelled modular transporters (SPMTs).

The modular design incorporates steel frames and lightweight concrete slabs, addressing the need for stability in an earthquake-prone region. Each module features moment and braced frames to provide structural integrity while allowing for expansive views along the concourse. This adaptability signifies a shift towards a more flexible architectural approach, enabling future modifications based on operational needs.

Inside, the design transitions from a focus on infrastructure to a sense of hospitality, featuring warm materials and comfortable spaces reminiscent of a 'living room'. The integration of terrazzo flooring and wood paneling enhances passenger comfort, offering a relaxing environment. By blending efficient operational functions with human-centered design principles, Woods Bagot reframes the airport experience as a space of relaxation rather than just transit.
chinese: 澳洲建築工作室Woods Bagot利用離場生產方式加速洛杉磯國際機場新衛星航廈的建設。這種創新方法擴展了湯姆·布拉德利國際航廈，增加了15萬平方英尺和八個登機門，同時確保機場運營的最小干擾。航廈結構在距離機場1.75英里處建造，並利用自移動模塊運輸器（SPMT）將其運送至現場。
模塊化設計融合了鋼框架和輕質混凝土板，應對了地震易發地區的穩定性需求。每個模塊都具有剛性框架和支撐框架，以提供結構完整性，同時在航廊中提供廣闊的視野。這種適應性標誌著建築方法向更靈活的方向轉變，使未來根據運營需求進行調整成為可能。
室內設計從基礎設施的聚焦轉向以賓客為中心的暖馨環境，材料選擇上使用了溫暖的色調和舒適的空間，讓人有居家般的親切感。連續的水磨石地板和木質內裝增強了乘客的舒適，提供了放鬆的環境。Woods Bagot通過將高效的運行功能與以人為本的設計原則相結合，重新定義了機場體驗，使其成為一個更具舒適感而非僅僅是過境的空間。

articles.topic: Tennessee Performing Arts Center Design by Bjarke Ingels
articles.title: bjarke ingels unveils tennessee performing arts center with billowing aluminum facade
english: The Tennessee Performing Arts Center, designed by Bjarke Ingels Group (BIG), is set to become a landmark in Nashville, also known as 'Music City'. Covering 307,000 square feet along the Cumberland River, it will serve as a crucial link between downtown and the city’s next phase of growth. The building features a dynamic, billowing aluminum facade that enhances its visibility and engages with the skyline.

The facade is designed to create welcoming multiple entrances, facilitated by deep openings at ground level. This innovative design not only enhances accessibility but also invites the public to interact with the space. The structure tilts from vertical to horizontal, forming canopies, thereby softening the edges and encouraging a flow of movement around the building.

Inside, the lobby is arranged as a stepped volume, facilitating circulation across multiple levels. This design fosters a communal atmosphere where audiences can mingle and share experiences before and after performances. With warm wood finishes and varied lighting, the interior balances the metallic exterior, creating a welcoming and vibrant public space.
chinese: 田納西表演藝術中心由比亞克·英格斯集團（BIG）設計，將成為納什維爾的地標，也被稱為‘音樂之城’。建築將覆蓋307,000平方英尺，沿著坎伯蘭河而建，將是市中心與城市下一階段增長之間的重要連結。這座建築擁有一個動感十足、起伏的鋁製外立面，增強了其可見性並與天際線相呼應。
這個外立面的設計使得多個入口變得友好，通過地面層的深開口來促進可及性。這一創新的設計不僅提高了便利性，還邀請公眾與該空間互動。結構在垂直和水平之間傾斜，形成頂棚，柔化邊緣，鼓勵人們在建築周圍流動。
室內的大廳以階梯形狀排列，促進多層次之間的流通。這種設計營造了共融的氛圍，使觀眾可以在演出前後交流和共享經驗。以溫暖的木材裝飾和多樣的照明，使內部空間平衡了金屬外觀，創造了一個友好而充滿活力的公共空間。
